description: This file defines a SwiftUI View struct 'ConfigSettings' which manages the user interface for configuration settings. It includes UI components, state management, and logic for loading and displaying configuration schemas and sections within a settings interface.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for displaying and editing configuration settings based on a schema, including sections and subsections navigation, with loading and saving capabilities.

classes.name: ConfigSection
classes.description: A struct representing a configuration section with key, label, help text, and schema node.

classes.name: ConfigSubsection
classes.description: A struct representing a subsection within a configuration section, with key, label, help text, schema node, and path.

classes.name: SubsectionSelection
classes.description: An enum representing the selection state of subsections: all or a specific key.

methods.name: sections
methods.description: Computes and returns the list of configuration sections based on the schema.

methods.name: activeSection
methods.description: Returns the currently selected active section.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: View component for displaying configuration sections in a sidebar.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: View component for displaying details of the selected section.

methods.name: sectionDetail
methods.description: Displays detailed configuration form and info for a specific section.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures that a section and subsection are selected when schema is loaded.

methods.name: selectSection
methods.description: Sets the active section and defaults its subsection.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and returns a list of ConfigSection objects from a schema node.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and returns subsections for a given section.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves and returns the relevant schema node considering anyOf/oneOf variants.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts a key string into a human-readable label.
